newsitem.title: USA: Reddi CEO quits, co closes 84 warehouses.
newsitem.headline: Reddi CEO quits, co closes 84 warehouses.

text.p: Reddi Brake Supply Corp said late Tuesday that Richard McGorrian had resigned as chief executive officer and president of it and its subsidiary, Reddi Brake Supply Co.
Additionally, the company said its subsidiary closed and secured all its 84 warehouses and laid off all its field employees and most administrative personnel as of March 18.
"The immediate closure and layoff was necessary due to the lack of sufficient capital on the part of the company or the subsidiary to continue operations," the company said in a release.

A group of four unsecured creditors of the subsidiary filed involuntary petition under Chapter 11 March 17. On Tuesday the company said it had filed a petition to convert its involuntary Chapter 11 proceeding to a voluntary case.

It said its goal in pursuing a reorganization under voluntary Chapter 11 is to attract additional capital to finance a reorganization and either to continue operating its subsidiary or to sell its assets.

It said its debtor-in-possession funding motion will be heard in court April 4. It said unless a definitive commitment for the capitalization or purchase of the subsidiary's assets is obtained by April 18, it plans to begin the liquidation of all assets.
The company said Sandford Waddell, its chief financial officer, has been appointed interim chief executive to replace McGorrian.
